_meta.description: The abstract Order primitive (REQ-ORD-001..003): ONE schema, discriminated by orderType, that models Subsidie (subsidie), PurchaseOrder (purchase) and DBAOpdracht (engagement) as a single transactional workspace, per the menu-IA audit's 'fold into the primitive' decision. `sales` is reserved on the discriminator for the future SalesOrder fold (NOT built by this change — no SalesOrder migration ships here). Each orderType keeps its OWN full field set as an optional, type-namespaced group (`subsidie`/`purchase`/`engagement`) so no regulatory or audit field is dropped, and its OWN lifecycle state vocabulary on the shared `state` field (gated per-transition by `orderType` — see x-openregister-lifecycle below). Money-unit note: PurchaseOrder's amounts are integer EURO CENTS (ADR-022); Subsidie/DBAOpdracht amounts are decimal EUR. The shared `totalAmount` is always decimal EUR — the purchase-group cent fields (totalExclVat/totalVat/totalInclVat) are preserved verbatim and totalAmount is derived by dividing by 100 at fold time. Composition-via-allOf was evaluated (see openspec/changes/abstract-order-primitive/SCHEMA-ANALYTICS-AND-PLAN.md) and REJECTED for this build: OpenRegister's ObjectService::findAll() is schema-scoped only (no allOf-aware cross-schema query — confirmed against SchemaMapper::resolveAllOf(), which merges `properties`/`required` but never queries across schemas), so a single-schema 'Order workspace' index can only ever show literal `OrderPrimitive` rows. The earlier partial build's `Grant` extension schema (zz-order-extensions.json, now removed) was ALSO a live slug collision with the pre-existing `Grant` (WBSO/BBV/NSO/Tozo) schema in shillinq_register.json — the two would have deep-merged via SettingsService::deepMergeConfig, corrupting the unrelated WBSO Grant schema. See tasks.md for the full account. SLUG NOTE (issue #503, 2026-07-23): the schema slug is `OrderPrimitive`, not the bare `Order` originally planned. Live-verification on 8080 found OpenRegister's schema lookup is CASE-INSENSITIVE and (in `ImportHandler::importSchema()`) explicitly bypasses multitenancy (`_multitenancy: false`) when checking for an existing schema by slug, so a slug is effectively unique INSTANCE-WIDE, not per-app or per-organisation. On the shared 8080 instance a `decidesk` schema (id 1585, slug `order`) already occupies that identifier in the SAME organisation as shillinq's own schemas — importing a schema literally named `Order` would have matched it via `LOWER(slug)` and (since `SchemaMapper::updateFromArray` is called on a match) OVERWRITTEN decidesk's live schema with this shape. `OrderPrimitive` avoids the collision and is distinctive enough to avoid future ones with any other app's generic nouns.

OrderPrimitive.title: Order
OrderPrimitive.description: The unified transactional workspace primitive (REQ-ORD-001) folding Subsidie (subsidie), PurchaseOrder (purchase) and DBAOpdracht (engagement) behind one `orderType` discriminator. `sales`/`booking`/`quote`/`blanket` are reserved discriminator values for future folds and are NOT populated by this change. Each type's full field set lives, unabridged, in its own optional field group (`subsidie`/`purchase`/`engagement`); the shared core (number, counterparty, currency, dates, total, state) is common. Lifecycle: `state` carries the UNION of every type's own vocabulary; each transition is scoped to exactly one `orderType` (x-openregister-lifecycle.transitions.*.orderType) so a subsidie Order can never attempt a purchase transition and vice-versa (REQ-ORD-002).

currency.title: Currency

orderDate.title: Order Date

endDate.description: The order's closing/expected-end date, when applicable.
endDate.title: End Date

totalAmount.description: Headline amount in decimal EUR (verleendBedrag / totalInclVat÷100 / verwachteOmzet). See the type group for the authoritative source field(s).
totalAmount.title: Total Amount

paymentTerms.description: Free-form payment terms, where applicable (purchase only today).
paymentTerms.title: Payment Terms

projectReference.description: Dimensional project tag, where applicable (purchase's projectCode today).
projectReference.title: Project Reference

costCenter.description: Dimensional cost-centre tag, where applicable (purchase's costCenter today).
costCenter.title: Cost Center

state.description: Lifecycle state. The legal subset and transitions depend on `orderType` — see x-openregister-lifecycle.initialStateByType and .transitions.*.orderType (REQ-ORD-002). subsidie: request..handled (identical to the retired Subsidie schema). purchase: draft..cancelled (identical to PurchaseOrder.statusCode). engagement: DRAFT..ENDED (identical to DBAOpdracht.intakeStatus).
state.title: State

determinedAmount.title: Vastgesteld Bedrag

paidOutAmount.title: Uitbetaald Bedrag

reclaimedAmount.title: Teruggevorderd Bedrag
